title: The Defiled Compendium: Layam Pedagogy Destroyed
dispute_text: A rare library book was returned water-damaged with torn pages
setting: College Library, Fine Arts Department, Book Return Counter
summary: A rare, heavily annotated copy of 'Layam Pedagogy in Carnatic Music' — irreplaceable and valued at Rs. 45,000 — was returned in a state of severe water damage with three pages torn. Library checkout photos prove it was in perfect condition when borrowed by Meera Krishnan.
